mechanism.claim: MSTR and COIN provide different listed-equity transmission channels into crypto risk. A large volatility-standardized MSTR-minus-COIN close shock identifies which channel led the completed US cash session; during elevated completed BTC variation, follow that relative leadership direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of standardized MSTR return minus standardized COIN return

external_support.inference_disclosure: The standardized relative shock, causal rank gates, BTC variation gate, latency and hold are outcome-blind preregistered adaptations, not a claimed published replication.

mechanism.why_distinct: Repository candidates use miner residuals, MSTR short volume, broad equity breadth, BTC-SPY coskewness, and BTC-equity residuals. HVCELSR directly contrasts two crypto-equity channels after scaling each by its own strictly prior volatility. It uses no miner basket, short volume, BTC return in the spread, derivatives, flow, funding, OI, fitted outcome, prior event set, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the absolute relative leadership shock must occupy its causal upper quartile and completed BTC variation its causal upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: official US equity-close leadership onsets with daylight-saving-aware entries are absent from Gross9

features.sessions: official common NYSE cash sessions with complete adjusted MSTR and COIN OHLCV rows
features.equity_returns: log adjusted_close_t/adjusted_close_(t-1 common session) independently for MSTR and COIN
features.strict_prior_scales: population standard deviation of at most 63 strictly prior valid common-session returns for each equity, minimum 42, current excluded; both finite strict positive
features.leadership_spread: current MSTR return/prior MSTR scale minus current COIN return/prior COIN scale; finite strict nonzero
features.magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(leadership_spread) over at most 270 earlier source-valid sessions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTCUSDT 1m log(close/open)) over exact 24 elapsed hours ending at official cash close
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid sessions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding official source-valid session ineligible; missing or invalid predecessor cannot trigger
features.missing: missing adjustment, session, BTC minute, duplicate, nonfinite or nonpositive source rejects; no imputation

clock.feature_available: five elapsed minutes after official close
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT five-minute open ten elapsed minutes after official close
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

equities.provider: Yahoo chart API current adjusted history
equities.official_session_validation: NYSE schedules and frozen early closes

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no symbols, adjustment, scaling window, spread, rank, onset, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, source, comparator, or control repair
